findings.title: Mount thrashing
findings.recommendation: Measure all initial values in a single read pass before writing any styles. Use requestAnimationFrame to separate the read and write phases.

findings.title: Off-screen animations
findings.recommendation: Only run animations when the element is visible. Use IntersectionObserver or a viewport-aware animation trigger like Motion's `inView()` or `whileInView`.
